description: From the Plaza de Santa Ana, the cathedral of Las Palmas fills the frame — its neoclassical facade and towers rising behind the famous bronze dogs that guard the square in the foreground. This is the historic heart of the Canarian capital — cathedral, square, and the eight bronze hounds that everyone photographs.
